You 'don't need to pay for AI API keys anymore'

how_to_steps: Pick a model marked 'Free Endpoint' (e.g. deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro)
On the model page, click 'Generate API Key' / 'Create API key'

Use the OpenAI-compatible snippet: from openai import OpenAI; client = OpenAI(base_url='https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1', api_key='nvapi-...'); client.chat.completions.create(model='deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro', ...)
on_screen_only: Python sample with base_url 'https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1', api_key beginning 'nvapi-' (partially visible), extra_body={'chat_template_kwargs': {'thinking': False}}, max_tokens, top_p, temperature, stream=False
Model page tabs: Build | Playground | Model Card; language tabs Python / LangChain / Node / Shell; 'Prototype — Start building with a free API endpoint.'

build.nvidia.com homepage: 'Use Inference Endpoints' and 'Use Agentic Skills — Pre-built capabilities your agent can call' (AI and Machine Learning 143 skills, Accelerated Computing 24 skills, Physical AI 10 skills, Developer Tools 9 skills); 'More Models', 'View Skills'

A Claude Code session with '.claude/settings.local.json', 'Playwright traces', todos: Update task model, Create webhook handles, Add UI components, Build and test; Search pattern 'http|request|handler|server', Read apiserver.ts (600 lines)
Disclaimer at bottom of model pages: 'AI models generate responses and outputs based on complex algorithms...'

relevance.why: Free OpenAI-compatible endpoints for open-weight frontier models are useful for cheap subagents, evals or batch jobs, but Claude Code's core loop needs Anthropic models; 'plug into Claude Code' is at best via a proxy.

implement_score.why: Worth a 10-minute signup to have a free fallback key for non-critical tasks; not worth re-architecting anything. Free tier almost certainly rate-limited and not for production.

verify: Actual rate limits and terms of the free endpoints on build.nvidia.com (requests/min, data retention, commercial use)
Whether 'OpenAI' models are really served free there or the creator conflated it
How one would actually route Claude Code to a non-Anthropic endpoint (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL proxy?) and whether it's worth it
Which models are 'Free Endpoint' vs 'Downloadable' only; many cards shown are downloadable only
